items.why: Retrieved 2026-08-09 from the openFDA drug-label endpoint for brand_name PROZAC. Section 2.9 states verbatim: "At least 14 days should elapse between discontinuation of an MAOI intended to treat psychiatric disorders and initiation of therapy with PROZAC. Conversely, at least 5 weeks should be allowed after stopping PROZAC before starting an MAOI intended to treat psychiatric disorders." identity.status is 'exception' rather than 'verified' because this is a REGULATORY LABELING statement, not a literature finding - no PubMed-indexed study reports these intervals as a result, so there is no bibliographic record to resolve. Scope note: this entry backs the >=5 week interval after fluoxetine and the >=14 day interval after an MAOI. It does NOT back the page's '>=2 weeks after stopping most SSRIs' generalization, which is a class statement drawn from other products' labeling - do not attach this source to it. The url is a live endpoint returning CURRENT labeling; the quotation above is the review record of what it said on the verification date.

Issue year is 2016 (Am J Psychiatry 173(2):117-27); PubMed records an electronic publication date of 2015-10-30, so both years appear in the wild - the issue year is used here. 37 articles, 5700 deliveries, 4023 patients.
